comment: potion.c djinni_from_bottle() (2815-2868) announces the djinni with a_monnam() (2826). The hero is hallucinating, so do_name.c x_monnam() takes the name from rndmonnam(), and when bogon_is_pname() says the bogus monster's name is a proper name it gets no article: "In a cloud of smoke, Dudley emerges!". The second smoky potion holds the djinni. The seed was found by replaying seeds 733100-733949 in the port until the hallucinated name had no article. The sibling recipe djinni-from-bottle-plain has a hero who is not hallucinating, "a djinni".
